name: gemini-live-voice-monorepo
description: Unified November 2026 Monorepo (Rust Crates + Bun v1.4.5 Packages + Python uv + Tauri v3 Alpha) for the One Big Gemini Voice, Audio & Music Super App

scripts.build:aot: bun build --compile --bytecode --minify apps/gemini_super_app/src/server.ts --outfile dist/bin/gemini-super-app.exe && bun build --compile --bytecode --minify scripts/gemini_24_7_supervisor.ts --outfile dist/bin/gemini-supervisor-24x7.exe && bun build --compile --bytecode --minify packages/gemini_app_plugin/mcp_server.ts --outfile dist/bin/gemini-app-runtime-mcp.exe
scripts.fmt: bun fmt packages scripts apps/gemini_super_app apps/gemini_windows_patcher/src
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --check packages scripts apps/gemini_super_app apps/gemini_windows_patcher/src
scripts.lint: bun lint packages scripts apps/gemini_super_app apps/gemini_windows_patcher/src
